Extraterrien est un podcast sportif fran: Extraterrien is a French-language sports podcast that approaches sport from a cultural and social angle. Beyond the scores, it explores what sport says about our societies and our values.
Un podcast sur le dépassement de soi à t: A podcast about pushing your limits through the lens of elite athletes — ultra-trail runners, mountaineers, extreme swimmers. A long, introspective format, with no tactical analysis or statistics: just the mindset, the psychological cost, the mechanics of effort. Motivation that comes through clarity rather than artificial enthusiasm. Our verdict: "Demanding, sincere, very personal. A podcast that talks about sport, of course, but above all about what it costs to go all the way." You rarely come out euphoric, but always more aware.
